name: @jadwigo/ui
description: Zeszyt's tokens and styles (Tailwind 4) and the neutral shadcn/ui primitives

//.@fontsource/andika: Andika, the Zeszyt type a child reads, loaded by src/styles/tailwind.css
//.@testing-library/react: renders a component in a *.test.tsx and queries it the way a person would
//.@types/node: Node 24 types for this package's typecheck (tsconfig.base.json names them)
//.@types/react-dom: types for react-dom in the component tests
//.class-variance-authority: the variants of the shadcn/ui primitives (src/primitives/button.tsx and friends)
//.happy-dom: the DOM the dom Vitest project runs *.test.tsx in, as the playground's tests do
//.lucide-react: the icons the primitives draw (a chevron, a check, a close cross)
//.radix-ui: the behaviour under the shadcn/ui primitives: popover, dialog (the sheet, src/primitives/sheet.tsx), tabs, select
//.react: the components in src/*.tsx; 18.3.1, the version the playground runs (dl-5ssh.34.6 ports it)
//.react-dom: React's renderer, which @testing-library/react renders the components with
//.tailwind-merge: lets a later Tailwind class win over an earlier one in cn() (src/lib/utils.ts)
//.tailwindcss: Tailwind 4, imported by src/styles/tailwind.css, which the app's build compiles
//.typescript: tsc for this package's typecheck script
//.vitest: runs this package's unit test with the root vitest.config.ts
